correctness.rationale: For each of 57 subsets of six nonparallel primitive normal vectors, the dual lattice index is the gcd of two-by-two minors and the sixfold rational convex polygon is integral. Exact rational shoelace area, edge-lattice gcd, and Pick/Ehrhart formula yield a polynomial for each subset at every width divisible by six. The standalone exhaustive symbolic checker gives grouped subset polynomials (60,60,15), (39,39,20), (21,21,15), (7,7,6), (1,1,1), whose binomial inversion gives all t_m. Infinity contributes six points of multiplicity 2n+1. Standard log-Chern formulas then give (86n²+62n−13, 36n²+24n−4) and limit 43/18. The independent direct projective intersection implementation verified n=6,12,18,24, and pair-count identity; finite tests are not used to infer the unrestricted formula.

value.rationale: The finding advances a specifically documented rational-geography open interval by providing a natural entire G2-root six-direction family, exact all-multiplicity stratification and full log-Chern polynomials. Its limit 43/18 increases the known explicit rational endpoint 19/8 by 1/72, and the preexisting density theorem converts it into a nontrivially enlarged certified interval of accumulation values. The novelty and value lie in an infinite geometrically motivated count and geography consequence, not a cheap isolated numerical test.
